dhp129:4:
ghātaye → prāṇā yathātamano’bhīṣṭā bhūtānāmpi te tathā 
ātemaෟpamyena bhūteṣū dayāṁ kurvanti sādhavaඃ (bj: hitopadeśa. 1. 2)
dhp131:4:
sukhaṁ → ahiṁsakāni bhūtāni daṇḍena vitihanti yaඃ 
ātmanaඃ sukhamicchan sa pretya naiva sukhī bhavet (bj: mahābhārata 13.5565); yo’hiṁsakāni bhūtāni hinasatyātmasukhecchayā 
sa jīvaṁśava mṛtaśaicva na kvavit sukhamedhate (bj: manusmṛti. 5. 45)

dhp141:4:
avitiṇṇakaṅkhaṁ → na naganacaryyā na jaṭā na paṅko 
nānāśanaṁ sathaṇḍilaśāyikā vā 
na rajomalaṁ notkuṭukapradhānaṁ 
viśodhayenemāhaviśīrṇakāṁkṣam (bj: divyāvadāna)
dhp142:4:
bhikkhu → alagito ya vi care a dhamu 
datu śatu sañatu brammayari 
savisu bhutesu nihai dana 
so bramaṇo so samaṇo so bhikhu (bj: prā, dha. B. 39); alaṁkṛtaśvāpi carena dharmaṁ 
dāntendriyaඃ śāntaඃ saṁyato brahmacārī 
savēṣū bhūteṣu nidhāya daṇḍaṁ 
sa brāhmaṇaඃ sa śramaṇaඃ sa bhikṣuඃ (bj: divyāvadāna)
